method_help.best_available: Each line takes its most mature figure: the final account, else the measured work, else the award, else the estimate, else the budget.
method_help.maximum: Each line takes the highest of its figures (budget, estimate, award, measured, invoiced), so the forecast never hides a risk.
method_help.evm_cpi: Each line projects its cost at completion from progress: the money spent so far divided by the share of the work done.
method_help.manual: A person sets the line's figure and links the document behind it.

has_pieces.fail: The job has no pieces to cut
has_pieces.suggestion: Add pieces by hand, paste them, or import them from a bending schedule, takeoff, a BOQ line or a file.

has_stock.fail: The job offers no stock to cut from
has_stock.suggestion: Add at least one stock length or sheet size, or reuse offcuts from site inventory.

sheet_dimensions.suggestion: Give every sheet piece and sheet size both a length and a width.

piece_fits_stock.fail: Piece {ref} ({size} mm) fits no stock entry
piece_fits_stock.suggestion: Add a longer or larger stock size, reduce the trim, or split the piece with a joint.

grain_allows_fit.fail: Piece {ref} fits only when turned across the grain
grain_allows_fit.suggestion: Allow rotation for this piece or add a sheet size that fits it along the grain.

kerf_set.suggestion: Enter the blade or cutting width, otherwise the yield of every bar with several cuts is overstated.

min_offcut_set.fail: No minimum usable offcut is set
min_offcut_set.suggestion: Set the shortest remnant worth keeping, so reusable offcuts are not counted as waste.

stock_priced.suggestion: Enter a price per piece so the plan reports its cost and picks the cheapest stock.

stock_sufficient.fail: Pieces not placed on the available stock: {count}
stock_sufficient.suggestion: Raise the available quantity or add another stock size.

yield_threshold.fail: Yield {actual} % is below the threshold of {threshold} %
yield_threshold.suggestion: Add another stock length or size, allow rotation, or review the threshold for this material.

figure.gross_development_value: The total sales value of every unit in the scheme, all in one currency.
figure.total_development_cost: Every cost of delivering the scheme except the land itself: construction, fees, contingency, finance and sales costs.
figure.residual_land_value: What is left for the land after the total development cost and the target developer profit are taken out of the gross development value.
figure.developer_profit: The profit the developer aims to keep, set as a target ratio of the gross development value.
figure.profit_on_cost: Developer profit divided by total development cost, carried as a ratio.
figure.profit_on_gdv: Developer profit divided by the gross development value, carried as a ratio.
